body: You may be able to name an old source of control without letting it run the current decision. When Pluto sextiles Lilith, a buried resentment, private rule, family pattern, unequal agreement, or fear of being punished can become easier to see without taking over the entire situation. That gives you a chance to respond without turning the correction into revenge. Say what happened, name what you will not repeat, and use any leverage you have to make the arrangement different now. The point is not to win the old fight. It is to stop organizing your choices around it.
